summary.fallback: The witch wants to brew medicine for the wounded animals caught between her hut and the village.

intro.fallback: Good. That means your village may still have room for reason. I need help creating some brews, would you be able to assist me?

offer.fallback: What do you need for the brews?
Sugar to keep the draught from turning bitter, and red mushrooms for the body of it. Simple things, if someone is willing to gather them.
The animals near the swamp. They panic when your hunters come close, and my wards are not gentle when panic crosses them.
Because if I walk toward the village, they will reach for blades. If you carry the ingredients, I can repair some of the harm without starting another quarrel.

return.fallback: You brought them. Good. Hold still while I sort what is useful from what is merely damp.

reward.fallback: Take these. The carrots will keep you standing, and the bottles will do more good in your hands than on my shelf.

done.fallback: The animals are resting easier. Do not mistake that for peace, but it is a start.
